We need to propose retrosynthesis route using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. Must have at least 3 reactions. So we need to apply template 1914393 first to target molecule, get precursors, then apply 1914394 to one of those precursors, then 1914395 to next, etc. Need to produce JSON route.

We need to get templates details maybe to know what they do. Use get_template for each ID.
